question: In 2023, Ajay Singh, the chief of SpiceJet was appointed as president of which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ASSOCHAM**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 2023, Ajay Singh, the chief of SpiceJet, was appointed as the president of **ASSOCHAM**.
 
• **ASSOCHAM** stands for the **Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India**.
